direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just received her phone back from Kasun. Her gratitude turns into curiosity about his small food business.
direction.people: Anudi stands frame left facing right, wearing a plain cream blouse and muted teal skirt. She holds her phone low at her right waist, an open umbrella in her left hand and a handbag on her left forearm; she is relaxed and warmly interested. Kasun remains off screen to her right.

flow.text: Anudi keeps a small smile, her returned phone resting low at her right waist. Her eyes travel toward the food three-wheeler in the right background, then return to Kasun.

flow.to: Kasun, off screen to her right
flow.how: warm and friendly-polite, genuinely curious about whether the business is his, lifting her chin slightly toward him with her smile retained

flow.text: She keeps her gaze on Kasun, her expression open as she waits for his answer.

direction.camera: Eye-level roadside medium shot on a 50mm lens, Anudi waist up at frame left with the three-wheeler edge in right depth, in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain and distant road traffic beneath her conversational voice; no music.
